$comment: The ONE owner of what the public tree is: which paths never leave the companion, which companion files are exported under a public name, which files may spell the patterns below, and which strings must not appear in anything published. Read by scripts/lib/public-tree.mjs for both the publish check (pnpm verify:public) and the sync. `tree` says which repository this checkout is; the export rewrites it to `public` and nothing else.

forbidden.name: personal-path
forbidden.why: a path on one person's machine is a path nobody else can follow

forbidden.name: credential
forbidden.why: a credential in a public tree is published the moment it is pushed

forbidden.name: citation
forbidden.why: a section mark cites a document nobody outside can read; docs/media/ is exempt because compressed video decodes to stray section marks by chance and a rule that reports noise is a rule people learn to ignore

forbidden.name: vocabulary
forbidden.why: a term from the private workflow names something a contributor cannot open; a milestone letter (M0–M8) names the delivery plan, which is not published. A requirement number (FR-016, SC-004) names a clause of a specification that is not published, so it points nowhere for a reader.; docs/media/ is exempt because compressed video matches these short tokens by chance in its bytes, which is noise rather than a finding

forbidden.name: copyright-owner
forbidden.why: the copyright line names the owner, and LICENSE drifted from NOTICE to an individual — a third-party notice writes its year differently and is untouched by this
